does: Brings hot food down to the cold of the fridge quickly, so that it keeps well and so that a cold dish is truly cold.
how: Move the hot food out of its pot into a wide, shallow container.
Stand the container in iced water and stir now and then.
Put it in the fridge, uncovered, once it has stopped steaming.
Cover it when it is cold. Taste a cold dish again before serving, because cold dulls salt.

cues.text: The container is cold to the hand all over, with no warm core.

mistakes.mistake: Leaving a large pot of stock to cool by itself on the stove, where its middle stays warm for a long time.
mistakes.fix: Divide it into shallow containers and cool them in iced water.

mistakes.mistake: Seasoning a soup while it is hot and serving it cold.
mistakes.fix: Taste it again when it is cold.
